           VP Engineering & Product · AI-Native Enterprise Platforms · Financial Services & InsurTech

Summary
Engineering and product executive who scales products and teams from MVP to enterprise production. Most
recently served as Vice President of Engineering & Product at Indico Data, where I helped evolve the company’s
product from a sales demo in 2017 to a widely adopted document processing platform that processes billions of
transactions per year. Earlier built financial and identity platforms at GMO (order, trade, and reconciliation
systems for a global asset manager) and Amazon (identity, OAuth, and authorization platform).
Highlights
   • Grew Indico’s engineering organization from 4 to 23 across development, DevOps, QA, and product while
     cutting R&D spend by $1M+ year over year.
   • Delivered Indico Workspaces, an agentic underwriting and claims platform: 5+ accounts, $500K new ARR
     in 8 months.
   • Moved Intake, Indico’s document-AI platform, from discriminative deep learning to LLM agents, RAG, and
     LLM-based evaluation without breaking customer accuracy, isolation, or uptime commitments.
